Chapter 6828: Bear Immortal

Chapter 6828: Bear Immortal

“Formations!” The ancient ancestors ordered.

A golden light erupted in Thunder Kingdom as everyone worked to empower it.

“Buzz.” Arrays appeared and formed a grand formation. Cultivators sent their true blood and chaos true energy into the formation, not holding back in the slightest.

Golden walls stacked on top of each other. As the group showed their determination, lamps of the dao heart lit up everywhere.

However, the bolts exceeded their imagination and broke through the walls like they were paper.

Everything was flattened, whether it was mountains or oceans. Only scorched land was left along the way.

“Not good!” The ancient ancestors turned pale upon seeing the calamity. No one in Thunder Kingdom would survive.

“Retreat to the capital!” They gave the order for everyone to gather.

The next defense - the lights of the dao heart - momentarily stopped the bolts.

“We guard with our lives!” Thunder Emperor shouted and stabilized her dao heart.

As she and her allies showed absolute conviction, more lamps appeared in Thunder Kingdom. Power rushed out to stop the bolts, albeit still limited.

“Ahh!” The waves enveloped and murdered cultivators.

“Bear Immortal, please save us!” Blaze Ancestor shouted. If this continued, Thunder Kingdom would be wiped off the map.

He prostrated in the direction of the mountain.

“Please save us!” The others did the same.

“Pop!” The mountain became resplendent. Was it due to the connection between Blaze Ancestor and Bear Immortal?

This immortal power swept through Stygian and the image of a great bear appeared above the mountain.

“Boom!” The immortal force repelled the lightning waves, revealing a figure lying on the ground.

Meanwhile, the combatants noticed this explosion and paused their battle.

Their defenses were useless against the immortal force, resulting in broken bones and pulverized flesh.

“Bear Immortal!” They turned pale.

This was the difference between overlords and an immortal. Although Bear Immortal had yet to appear, just the eruption alone could defeat any overlord.

“Bear Immortal!” On the contrary, the defenders were ecstatic to see the figure of the bear.

This immortal had been dormant for one hundred thousand years. There were rumors of him having left Golden Lamp.

However, this showed they hadn't been abandoned. Bear Immortal was still here to protect Golden Lamp.

As for the overlords, they immediately thought about escaping. Yet, this was easier said than done.
